title: COGENT: Continuous Graph Emulators with Neural Ordinary Differential Equations for Long-Term Physical Forecasting
title_zh: COGENT：用于长期物理预测的 Neural ODE 连续图模拟器
abstract_en: In this work, we present COGENT, a continuous graph emulator with Neural Ordinary Differential Equations for long-term physical forecasting on irregular geospatial meshes. COGENT encodes a finite history of system states and associated forcing fields and external forcings with a graph-based history encoder, producing node-wise context vectors that capture both local spatial interactions and temporal evolution. These context vectors initialize and condition a latent Neural Ordinary Differential Equation whose dynamics are driven by interpolated future forcings and explicit relative rollout time. By modeling the forecast trajectory as a continuous latent dynamical system, COGENT can generate predictions at arbitrary future times rather than being restricted to a fixed temporal discretization. A residual decoder maps the resulting latent trajectories back to future physical states, enabling direct multi-step forecasting without repeatedly feeding predicted states back into the model. This formulation combines graph-based spatial representation, history-conditioned latent dynamics, and continuous-time rollout in a unified framework for mesh-based physical simulation emulation. In order to stabilize training with long-horizon supervision, we also propose effective rollout-horizon sampling and a progressive rollout-horizon scheduling strategy. We evaluate COGENT on transient ice-sheet simulations generated by the Ice-sheet and Sea-level System Model, demonstrating improved long-range stability over autoregressive graph baselines. These results suggest that continuous graph Neural ODEs provide a promising methodology for scalable physical forecasting on irregular geospatial meshes, particularly in applications that require stable long-horizon predictions and the ability to query system states at arbitrary times.
abstract_zh: 本文提出 COGENT，一种面向不规则地理空间网格长期物理预测的连续图模拟器。COGENT 使用基于图的历史编码器，对有限历史系统状态、相关 forcing fields 与 external forcings 进行编码，生成逐节点上下文向量，以同时捕获局部空间交互与时间演化信息。这些上下文向量用于初始化并条件化一个潜在 Neural Ordinary Differential Equation，其动力学由插值后的未来 forcings 和显式相对 rollout time 驱动。通过将预测轨迹建模为连续潜在动力系统，COGENT 能在任意未来时间生成预测，而不受固定时间离散步长限制。随后，residual decoder 将潜在轨迹映射回未来物理状态，实现直接多步预测，避免自回归方法中反复将预测状态作为输入导致的误差累积。为稳定长时域监督训练，作者还提出 rollout-horizon sampling 与 progressive rollout-horizon scheduling。实验在 Ice-sheet and Sea-level System Model 生成的瞬态冰盖模拟上进行，结果显示 COGENT 相比自回归图基线具备更好的长期稳定性。
key_points_zh: COGENT 将图神经网络的空间建模与 Neural ODE 的连续时间潜在动力学结合，适用于不规则地理空间网格上的物理系统模拟替代建模。
模型通过历史编码器融合有限历史状态、forcing fields 与 external forcings，生成节点级上下文向量，用于条件化后续连续时间动力系统。
相比固定时间步预测，COGENT 可在任意未来时间查询系统状态，并通过 residual decoder 直接输出多步预测，减少自回归误差累积。
训练上提出 rollout-horizon sampling 和 progressive rollout-horizon scheduling，以提升长时域监督下的稳定性。
在 Ice-sheet and Sea-level System Model 的瞬态冰盖模拟任务中，COGENT 相比自回归图基线展现出更好的长期预测稳定性。

llm_assessment.comment: A geophysical simulation-emulation method that falls outside the agent harness evolution scope.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该地球物理仿真代理模型方法不属于代理运行时演进范畴。
